source_record.title: Locum Dispensing Pharmacist
source_record.description:
Montu UK is seeking a locum Dispensing Pharmacist to join our dynamic, fast paced pharmacy team based in Winnersh Triangle, near Reading.

Location: Onsite in Winnersh, (easily accessible from Reading and surrounding areas)

Free parking onsite.

Rate: £35 to £40 per hour

Hours: 40 hours per week

This is an excellent opportunity for a dedicated pharmacist who thrives in a dynamic environment and is passionate about delivering exceptional patient care.

You will be working closely with our dispensing team to ensure efficient and accurate preparation of prescriptions while maintaining high regulatory and safety standards.

About you:

  • GPhC registered Pharmacist with relevant dispensing experience.

  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast paced setting

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to patient safety

  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills

This role offers regular locum work with the option to secure an enhanced rate for a short term commitment. If you are looking for stability while retaining flexibility, this could be the perfect fit.

Apply Now
If you thrive in a high-volume environment and are passionate about providing top-notch patient care, we would love to hear from you. Apply now to become part of our supportive, innovative team shaping the future of healthcare.

About Montu

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM). We are committed to transforming lives by improving access to safe, effective treatments and offering an exceptional standard of care. Our dynamic and supportive work environment is the perfect place for you to grow professionally while making a meaningful impact on patients’ lives.
